title: Contradiction
description: One measured gap between a declared intention and observed behavior. Two doctrines are enforced by this schema rather than by convention. First, a contradiction requires a PATTERN: observed_days is an array with minItems 2, so a single day cannot be recorded as a contradiction at all, and the severity rules raise that floor further. Second, a contradiction is investigated conversationally with the user BEFORE it is recorded: investigated_with_user false forces the status back to held_for_investigation. The record holds a count and a gap, never a verdict on the person. There is deliberately no field for a judgement, a character trait, a fault or a score, and additionalProperties is false at every level so none can be added. Any third party is a single given name and nothing more.

source.description: The entry or session this was detected in

intention.description: The declared intention, in the user's own words where possible

observed_days.description: The distinct days on which the gap was visible. minItems 2 is the pattern requirement: one day is a day, not a pattern, and the schema refuses to record it as one.

evidence.description: Observed behavior only. Every line is something a camera and a clock would agree with. No interpretation is expressible here: the item has no field for a meaning, a cause or a judgement.

gap.description: One sentence naming the distance between intention and behavior. No adjective about the person.

possible_cause.description: A hypothesis, held as a hypothesis, ideally the user's own from the investigation

severity.description: emerging is 2 to 3 observed days, established is 4 to 6, structural is 7 or more. The floors are enforced below.

investigated_with_user.description: True only when the gap was raised conversationally and the user answered. A large share of candidate contradictions die here, and that death is the finding.

withdrawn_reason.description: Why it was not a contradiction after all: a constraint, an obligation, or an intention that has changed and the list had not caught up

allOf.description: Investigate before recording. An uninvestigated gap can only be held, never recorded.
A recorded contradiction carries one next experiment. A named gap with no test is a complaint.
Severity floors follow the observed-day count rather than the writer's impression.
Structural means at least a week of it.
A withdrawal states what was learned instead.

fact_ref.description: A fact id from the journal entry this was derived from

observation.description: What was observed, countable and dated. Not what it meant.

experiment.description: One test, runnable within days, preferably a change to conditions rather than a demand for more willpower

observable_result.description: What will be true or false when it has run
